d:
Expedition Unknown: After the Search brings Josh Gates and psychic medium Chip Coffey together to revisit intriguing investigations and explore what may have been missed the first time around. As Josh looks back at the discoveries and evidence, Chip brings his own perspective to the mysteries. Could their combined insights reveal something that the original expeditions left unanswered?
Watch Expedition Unknown: After the Search, Season 2, Episodes 4, 1 and 3, on Discovery Channel India.
